entities.summary: The Zumurrud Khatun Mausoleum, also known as the Tomb of Sitta Zubayda, is a mosque and shrine located in Baghdad, in the Baghdad Governorate of Iraq. The structure contains the tomb of Zumurrud Khatun, and dates from the Abbasid era. It is located in Sheikh Ma'ruf Cemetery in the Karkh side of Baghdad, and the site was built at the patronage of Zumurrud and her son. Zumurrud was the wife of the 33rd Abbasid caliph, al-Mustadi and mother of Caliph al-Nasir. She collected the waqf money from madrasas and built her mausoleum, located in Karkh, before her death.
